title: Job tracker for open accounting & analytics roles at Big 4 and mid-size accounting firms

requirements.text: Implement Internet Identity sign-in so each user can maintain their own job tracker data (saved jobs, application status, notes) tied to their principal.

quotes: Create a new job tracker for me. All the accounting and analytics job postings that are open in Big 4 firms and mid-size accounting firms.

acceptanceCriteria: User can sign in/out with Internet Identity
After signing in, the user sees only their own tracker data (no cross-user leakage)
Unauthenticated users can browse the job list but cannot save jobs or change tracker fields (prompt to sign in)

requirements.text: Create a backend data model and API for job postings, firms, and user tracking fields. Job posting fields must include: id, title, firmId, firmName, category (Accounting|Analytics), location (free text), postingUrl, datePosted (optional), employmentType (optional), and open/closed status. User tracking fields must include: saved (boolean), applicationStatus (Not applied|Applied|Interviewing|Offer|Rejected|Withdrawn), notes (text), and lastUpdated timestamp.

quotes: All the accounting and analytics job postings that are open in Big 4 firms and mid-size accounting firms.

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes query methods to list open job postings with filtering by firm, category, and keyword search
Backend exposes methods to save/unsave a job and to update user-specific applicationStatus and notes
Backend stores data persistently across canister upgrades using stable data structures appropriate for Motoko

requirements.text: Seed the app with an initial firm directory that includes the Big 4 (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG) and supports adding/editing mid-size firms via an in-app admin-style UI (no external integrations required).

quotes: Big 4 firms and mid-size accounting firms.

acceptanceCriteria: Firm list initially contains Deloitte, PwC, EY, and KPMG
User can add a new firm with name and careers page URL (optional)
Job postings reference firms by firmId and display firm name consistently in the UI

requirements.text: Build the core job board UI: a searchable, filterable list of open job postings with filters for firm, category (Accounting/Analytics), and location keyword. Each job must show title, firm, location, category, and a link to the posting URL.

quotes: All the accounting and analytics job postings that are open...

acceptanceCriteria: User can filter the job list by firm and by category
User can search by keyword across title and location
Clicking a job opens a details view (modal or page) that includes the posting URL link and tracking controls (save/status/notes when signed in)

requirements.text: Add a 'My Tracker' view that shows only jobs the signed-in user has saved, grouped or filterable by applicationStatus, with quick actions to update status and edit notes.

quotes: Create a new job tracker for me.

acceptanceCriteria: My Tracker is available only when signed in
Saved jobs appear in My Tracker with current applicationStatus and notes preview
User can update applicationStatus and notes and see changes reflected immediately

requirements.text: Provide a simple job ingestion workflow suitable for maintaining 'all open postings' without scraping: allow authorized users to create/edit/close job postings via UI and support bulk import by pasting CSV text (title, firmName, category, location, postingUrl, open).

quotes: All the accounting and analytics job postings that are open...

acceptanceCriteria: There is a UI to add a single job posting and to mark a posting as closed
There is a bulk import screen that accepts pasted CSV and reports row-level validation errors
Imported jobs appear in the open job list immediately after successful import

requirements.text: Add lightweight analytics dashboards: (1) counts of open jobs by firm and by category, (2) counts of saved jobs by applicationStatus for the signed-in user, and (3) a trend indicator based on datePosted when available.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard renders open job counts by firm and category
When signed in, dashboard shows the user's saved-job counts by applicationStatus
If datePosted exists for any jobs, the UI shows a basic time-series or recent-postings breakdown; otherwise the UI gracefully indicates 'Date data not available'

requirements.text: Apply a coherent visual theme across the app (layout, typography, component styling) suitable for an accounting/career-tracking tool: warm neutral palette (e.g., sand/cream/charcoal), clear data-dense tables/cards, and restrained accent color (not blue/purple).
acceptanceCriteria: All core screens (Job Board, Job Details, My Tracker, Import, Dashboard) share consistent styling and spacing
Theme avoids blue & purple as the primary palette
UI remains readable for data-heavy lists (appropriate contrast, typographic hierarchy)

requirements.text: Generate and include static visual assets for the app (logo and empty-state illustration) and render them in the UI from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not route images through the backend).
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the frontend
Logo is displayed in the app header/nav
Empty-state illustration is displayed when My Tracker has no saved jobs

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in the main actor file; add migration code only if an upgrade requires it
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths provided by the platform; compose UI using those components instead
Do not implement third-party authentication providers; only Internet Identity is allowed
Do not rely on external databases or third-party scraping services
nonGoals: Automated web scraping of Big 4 or mid-size firm career sites
Integration with external ATS systems (Workday, Greenhouse, etc.)

required: Minimal geometric logo mark with briefcase + bar-chart motif, warm neutral palette (job-tracker-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Empty-state illustration of a tidy desk with a checklist and a small chart, warm neutral palette (empty-tracker-illustration.dim_1200x800.png)
